name: Spunweb Nonwoven Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2015, Spunweb Nonwoven Limited is a manufacturer and supplier of non-woven fabrics, primarily used for applications like doormats, bags, carpets, and tarpaulins.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Spunweb Nonwoven is one of the largest manufacturers of polypropylene spunbond nonwoven fabrics in India, with an installed capacity of 32,640 MTPA as of FY24. The company serves diverse sectors like hygiene, healthcare, packaging, agriculture, construction, industrial, and home furnishing.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 80.4 to 97.5 days.
